title: -R420 Carbon Carbon

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Scorpion EXO R420 Carbon Carbon is engineered for responsive sport riding with pinpoint lateral stability, pairing agile street ergonomics with certified multi-impact protection. Built around a Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell weighing a featherweight 1317g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~86 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT, Snell M2020, ECE 22.05 benchmarks. Inside, 3D laser-cut cheek pads tailor naturally to an Intermediate Oval profile with dedicated eyewear relief channels, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for confident all-day riding.

product_details.description: Scorpion carbon full face with Snell cert.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for oval head shapes; may feel tight on very round heads due to carbon fiber shell stiffness.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Scorpion EXO -R420 Carbon Carbon: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Scorpion EXO's Full Face lineup, the -R420 Carbon Carbon brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, Snell M2020, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Scorpion EXO R420 Carbon Carbon represents Scorpion EXO's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~86 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Scorpion EXO R420 Carbon Carbon delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
